description: Names and hints for the security template (secedit INF) settings that iG Windows Tuner explains. Settings not listed here are still shown and preserved, with their raw name.

systemAccess.name: Minimum password age (days)
systemAccess.hint: Days a password must be used before it can be changed (0 = any time).

systemAccess.name: Maximum password age (days)
systemAccess.hint: Days before a password expires (0 or -1 = never). A value below the age of your password makes it expire now.

systemAccess.name: Minimum password length
systemAccess.hint: Shortest allowed password; applies at the next password change.

systemAccess.name: Password must meet complexity requirements
systemAccess.hint: 1 requires three of: upper case, lower case, digits, symbols; applies at the next change.

systemAccess.name: Enforce password history
systemAccess.hint: Number of previous passwords that cannot be reused.

systemAccess.name: Store passwords using reversible encryption
systemAccess.hint: Must stay 0: 1 stores passwords in a recoverable form.

systemAccess.name: Account lockout threshold
systemAccess.hint: Failed sign-ins before an account is locked (0 = never lock).

systemAccess.name: Account lockout duration (minutes)
systemAccess.hint: Minutes an account stays locked (0 = until an administrator unlocks it). Must be at least the reset time.

systemAccess.name: Reset account lockout counter after (minutes)
systemAccess.hint: Minutes after a failed sign-in until the counter resets; at most the lockout duration.

systemAccess.name: Allow Administrator account lockout
systemAccess.hint: 1 lets the lockout policy lock the built-in Administrator too.

systemAccess.name: Accounts: Administrator account status
systemAccess.hint: 0 disables the built-in Administrator account (refused when it is the last enabled administrator).

systemAccess.name: Accounts: Guest account status
systemAccess.hint: Must stay 0: the Guest account allows sign-in without a password.

systemAccess.name: Accounts: Rename administrator account
systemAccess.hint: Name of the built-in Administrator account.

systemAccess.name: Accounts: Rename guest account
systemAccess.hint: Name of the built-in Guest account.

systemAccess.name: Network access: Allow anonymous SID/Name translation
systemAccess.hint: Must stay 0: 1 lets anonymous users look up account names.

systemAccess.name: Network security: Force logoff when logon hours expire
systemAccess.hint: 1 ends SMB sessions outside a user's logon hours.

privilegeRights.name: Access this computer from the network
privilegeRights.hint: Needed for file sharing and for Remote Desktop with Network Level Authentication.

privilegeRights.name: Allow log on locally
privilegeRights.hint: Needed to sign in at the console. Administrators and you always keep it.

privilegeRights.name: Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services
privilegeRights.hint: Needed to sign in over Remote Desktop.

privilegeRights.name: Log on as a batch job
privilegeRights.hint: Used by scheduled tasks that run with a stored password.

privilegeRights.name: Log on as a service
privilegeRights.hint: Used by services that run as a user account.

privilegeRights.name: Deny access to this computer from the network
privilegeRights.hint: Overrides the allow right. Never contains you while you use Remote Desktop.

privilegeRights.name: Deny log on locally
privilegeRights.hint: Overrides the allow right. Never contains you or Administrators.

privilegeRights.name: Deny log on through Remote Desktop Services
privilegeRights.hint: Overrides the allow right. Never contains you while you use Remote Desktop.

privilegeRights.name: Deny log on as a batch job
privilegeRights.hint: Overrides the allow right for scheduled tasks.

privilegeRights.name: Deny log on as a service
privilegeRights.hint: Overrides the allow right for services.

privilegeRights.name: Shut down the system
privilegeRights.hint: Who can shut down the PC while signed in.

privilegeRights.name: Force shutdown from a remote system
privilegeRights.hint: Who can shut down the PC over the network.

privilegeRights.name: Change the system time
privilegeRights.hint: Who can change the clock.

privilegeRights.name: Change the time zone
privilegeRights.hint: Who can change the time zone.

privilegeRights.name: Bypass traverse checking
privilegeRights.hint: Needed by almost everything; keep the Windows default.

privilegeRights.name: Increase a process working set
privilegeRights.hint: Lets processes reserve more physical memory.

privilegeRights.name: Create symbolic links
privilegeRights.hint: Developer Mode grants symbolic links separately.

privilegeRights.name: Debug programs
privilegeRights.hint: Full access to every process; Administrators only.

privilegeRights.name: Act as part of the operating system
privilegeRights.hint: Highest privilege; normally nobody.

privilegeRights.name: Load and unload device drivers
privilegeRights.hint: Kernel code; Administrators only.

privilegeRights.name: Take ownership of files or other objects
privilegeRights.hint: Bypasses file permissions; Administrators only.

privilegeRights.name: Back up files and directories
privilegeRights.hint: Reads every file regardless of permissions.

privilegeRights.name: Restore files and directories
privilegeRights.hint: Writes every file regardless of permissions.

privilegeRights.name: Impersonate a client after authentication
privilegeRights.hint: Services only; a common privilege-escalation path.

privilegeRights.name: Replace a process level token
privilegeRights.hint: Services only.

privilegeRights.name: Create a token object
privilegeRights.hint: Normally nobody.

privilegeRights.name: Manage auditing and security log
privilegeRights.hint: Can clear the Security log; Administrators only.

privilegeRights.name: Modify firmware environment values
privilegeRights.hint: UEFI variables; Administrators only.

privilegeRights.name: Perform volume maintenance tasks
privilegeRights.hint: Raw volume access; Administrators only.

weakening.reason: Enables the Guest account (sign-in without a password).
Lets anonymous users translate SIDs and account names.
